picks.name: C-Powers
picks.source_note: Welt Discos already seeded. Extremely dry research day (100+ searches across labels and artists, with several year-confusion false positives caught and dropped along the way -- Niagara "Pais & Filhos" turned out to be 2020, Batu "I Own Your Energy" 2021, 96 Back/Local Action and Timedance leads all older than they first appeared). This is a genuine new-to-the-pool discovery, about a month old, disclosed per usual practice. Exact release-page link unconfirmable via search, so the purchase link points to the label's confirmed-live Bandcamp root.
picks.bio: C-Powers is a US producer/DJ (active in Atlanta's queer rave scene) whose track "Need Ur Love" appears on "Back in the Pocket: The Sounds of Welt Discos Vol. II" (October 1, 2026, Welt Discos) -- a various-artists compilation from Joe Delon's Lisbon label, reviewed by DJ Mag for its washed-out, acidic euphoria.
picks.why_listen: A rave-damaged acid cut with a queer-club lineage, surfaced through a label-watch compilation -- good for a sweatier, more raw-sounding turn in a set.

release.title: Need Ur Love (Back in the Pocket Vol. II comp)
